description: Publication metadata for every public note, keyed by the stable Notion id (topic root page id or child page blockId). Missing, duplicate, or stale ids fail the build. status is one of Working note, Reviewed note, Archived; notes stay Working note until a person reviews them and records reviewedAt. Nothing promotes a note automatically. route and title are informational and validated against the generated route. Run node scripts/sync-publication-sidecar.js after pulling new notes.

statuses.Working note: Incomplete or not yet checked. Known factual errors are still corrected.
statuses.Reviewed note: Praneeth checked claims, examples, links, and layout on reviewedAt (not peer review).
statuses.Archived: Retained but no longer maintained; archiveReason is required.
